verdict.rationale: Working Copy's own manual documents a Repository Agent, an AI assistant operated through conversation, that can browse, search, read and modify files and also commit, pull and push. The homepage lists a Code Agent as an opt-in feature. That covers natural-language operation of the product's core git workflow. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the agent works as described, and in-depth documentation of its scope and limits (which operations it cannot do, and how it handles branches, merges and conflicts).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Repository Agent is an AI assistant that you interact with through conversation. Ask it to browse files, search content, read and modify files, commit, pull and push.
Code Agent & commit suggestions. Respects your data with opt-in.
